systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Supercritical CO2 Assisted Spray Freeze-Drying (SFD) Tunnel Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Industrial Continuous Aseptic Lyophilization System (3-A Sanitary Standards 45-03 & 74-07 / EHEDG Class I)
systemArchitectures.atomizationTechnology: Supercritical CO2 Effervescent Decompression Coaxial Micro-Nozzle (80–220 bar, 32–42°C)
systemArchitectures.freezingChamberType: Continuous Cryogenic Liquid Nitrogen Counter-Current Spray Column (-196°C to -120°C)
systemArchitectures.dryingChamberType: Continuous Multi-Zone Vibrating Vacuum Sublimation Belt Tunnel (0.05–0.25 mbar, -25°C to +20°C)
systemArchitectures.nozzleMaterial: Tungsten Carbide Micro-Orifice with AISI 316L Electropolished Sanitary Housing (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm)
systemArchitectures.sublimationBeltMaterial: Food-Grade PTFE-Coated Electropolished Stainless Steel Mesh (FDA 21 CFR § 177.1550)
systemArchitectures.co2RecoverySystem: Closed-Loop Closed-Circuit Supercritical CO2 Liquefaction & Recompression Unit (>96.5% Recovery)
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Triple Redundant ASME Section VIII Overpressure Rupture Discs & Cryogenic Oxygen Depletion Warning System
systemArchitectures.description: Flagship industrial-scale continuous supercritical CO2-assisted spray freeze-drying (SFD) plant engineered for bulk manufacturing of live probiotic cultures, therapeutic food enzymes, bioactive peptides, and liposomal dietary ingredients. Combines gentle supercritical CO2 effervescent micro-atomization with ultra-rapid cryogenic vitrification in liquid nitrogen and continuous multi-zone low-temperature vacuum belt sublimation, eliminating thermal degradation and yielding free-flowing meso-porous micro-particles.

systemArchitectures.name: Aseptic Continuous Vibrating Fluidized-Bed Spray Freeze-Dryer (V-SFD)
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Fluidized Cryogenic Lyophilizer (EHEDG EL Class I Aseptic / ISO 22000)

systemArchitectures.sublimationBeltMaterial: Perforated Sintered Metal Fluidizing Grid with Piezoelectric Vibro-Excitation
systemArchitectures.co2RecoverySystem: Multistage Cryogenic Condenser & Supercritical Boost Compressor (>97.8% Efficiency)

systemArchitectures.description: High-intensity continuous vibrating fluidized-bed spray freeze-dryer tailored for ultrafine biomolecules, high-titer vaccine vectors, and infant nutritional protein hydrolysates. Vibro-fluidization prevents agglomeration of frozen micro-droplets during primary ice sublimation, boosting drying rates by 40% compared to static trays.

bioproductFeedstocks.name: Thermolabile Food Protease & Lactase Enzyme Formulation
bioproductFeedstocks.description: Enzymatic brewing, baking, and dairy processing catalysts. Thermal inactivation and active-site catalytic triad distortion are completely averted via non-thermal cryogenic vitrification.

bioproductFeedstocks.description: Sub-micron lipid vesicles carrying sensitive fat-soluble vitamins. The low glass transition temperature requires deep vacuum primary sublimation (<0.07 mbar) to prevent lipid fusion, phase separation, and cake shrinkage.
